faq.title: What you'd want to know beforehand.

items.question: How much does a website for apartments or worker accommodation cost?
items.answer: It depends on the scope: number of pages, image material, languages and the features you want. Our packages and prices give you a guide. You receive a concrete quote after a short conversation, with no obligation.

items.question: Do you build websites for accommodation in Münster and the surrounding area?
items.answer: Yes. We build websites for apartments, worker accommodation and holiday lets in Münster, the Münsterland region and across Germany. Coordination and delivery work conveniently online.

items.question: Is Apartament Demo a real client project?
items.answer: No. Apartament Demo is a fictional business that we built as a concept project to show our work on an accommodation topic. Concept projects are labelled as such in the portfolio.

items.question: What if my photos are not professional?
items.answer: That is not an obstacle. In the concept, weak photos became a credible presence through a uniform visual language, floor plans and clear typography. We discuss what is possible with your material.

items.question: What material do I need to get started?
items.answer: Ideally photos of the apartments, floor plans or dimensions, the equipment list, location and contact details. If something is missing, we clarify in a conversation how to proceed.
